effect: Adding white cells and platelets completed the blood sample and the remaining goal.
reaction: The final picture brings the components together clearly, though it says little about what white cells and platelets do.

mostWorthwhile.text: Binding oxygen to red cells was most worthwhile: the planned double-arrow inset and explanation connect reversible haemoglobin binding to oxygen release in low-oxygen tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making plasma was straightforward but offered little explanation beyond showing water, solutes and proteins together.

surprise.text: The developing-cell cutaway made the transition from nucleated, protein-making precursors to mature red discs without nuclei especially clear.

arbitrary.text: The assembly actions had clear purposes, though adding white cells and platelets together left their distinct functions unexplained.

continue.text: I would continue: the oxygen-binding explanation connects a simple construction to physiology, and I would be curious to see how circulation brings oxygen to tissues.
